_comment: platform values: 'shopify'/'magento' = confirmed live, adapter used as-is. '*_unconfirmed' = plausible based on public signals but NOT verified live from this environment — run the curl check in README before trusting results, then flip to the confirmed value. 'custom' = needs a bespoke adapter module.

stores.name: Swaggle
stores.notes: Runs a Flybuys loyalty tie-in (Flybuys is Coles Group-linked) — worth watching for shared infra/pricing with Coles, though platform itself is unconfirmed.

stores.name: Pet Chemist
stores.notes: Smaller/specialty catalogue (animal health focus) — acquired by VetPartners in 2025, platform may have changed since.

stores.name: Petbarn
stores.notes: Confirmed running Magento (per a public case study of their app integration). GraphQL endpoint reachability not yet verified live — run the /graphql curl check in README before trusting results.

stores.name: Pet Circle
stores.notes: Runs on commercetools with a custom backend-for-frontend layer (their agency case study calls it 'Kraken D') — not Shopify, not standard Magento GraphQL either. The storefront likely calls its own internal REST/GraphQL API for product search, but the exact schema needs to be captured live from DevTools (Network tab, search a product, find the XHR call). Biggest catalogue of the group — build last, highest payoff, most engineering effort.

stores.name: Woolworths
stores.notes: Pet food category only. See woolworths_adapter.py — needs live endpoint capture before enabling.
